title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 197 (Ratification may be expressed or implied)

content.overview: Section 197 provides that ratification may be expressed or may be implied in the conduct of the person on whose behalf the acts are done.
content.glance: Ratification may be expressed or may be implied in the conduct of the person on whose behalf the acts are done.
content.study: Ratification may be expressed or may be implied in the conduct of the person on whose behalf the acts are done. Current-law framing: both express and implied ratification are recognised.

sections.heading: Core rule
sections.body: Ratification may be expressed or may be implied in the conduct of the person on whose behalf the acts are done.

examples.title: Implied ratification
examples.body: Ratification may be implied from the conduct of the person on whose behalf the acts were done under Section 197.

hypotheticals.question: May ratification be implied from conduct?
hypotheticals.analysis: Yes. Section 197 provides that ratification may be expressed or may be implied in the conduct of the person on whose behalf the acts are done.

enhancement.detailedExplanation: Section 197 provides that ratification may be expressed or may be implied in the conduct of the person on whose behalf the acts are done. This complements the right of election under Section 196.
examples: Conduct consistent with adoption of the acts may imply ratification.
distinctions: Form of ratification; knowledge requirements are in Section 198.
problemApplication: Conclude existence of ratification under Section 197.
keyTakeaways: Ratification may be expressed or implied from conduct.
